summary.text: Bill Stanley is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia for District 7, serving since 2011. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources, Commerce and Labor, and Courts of Justice.

paragraphs.text: William M. Stanley Jr. was born in Milton, Florida, on July 21, 1967, according to the Senate's member page.
The page says he earned a B.S. from Hampden-Sydney College and a J.D. from the District of Columbia School of Law, and lists his occupation as attorney.

The page lists his memberships as including the Coal and Energy Commission, the Tobacco Region Revitalization Commission and the Virginia Housing Commission, and says he chaired the board of directors of the New College Institute.
